The DFF output `q0` starts at its initial value `0`.

Each cycle:
- `inv = NAND(q0, q0) = NOT q0`
- output `q0` is recorded before the clock edge
- then `q0` loads `inv`, so it toggles every cycle

Cycle-by-cycle recorded `q0` values:

| Cycle | q0 before edge | inv = NOT q0 | Recorded q0 | q0 after edge |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 0 | 0 | 1 | 0 | 1 |
| 1 | 1 | 0 | 1 | 0 |
| 2 | 0 | 1 | 0 | 1 |
| 3 | 1 | 0 | 1 | 0 |
| 4 | 0 | 1 | 0 | 1 |
| 5 | 1 | 0 | 1 | 0 |
| 6 | 0 | 1 | 0 | 1 |
| 7 | 1 | 0 | 1 | 0 |
